lore.primalspells.trigger_fireball.desc: A slow-moving fireball that casts another spell on impact.
lore.primalspells.gravity.desc: Makes the spell affected by gravity.
lore.primalspells.piercing.desc: Unlimited piercing and self damage; returning projectiles can hit their caster.
lore.primalspells.bounce_explosion.desc: Causes the spell to explode on each bounce.
lore.primalspells.homing.desc: Causes the spell to track the nearest entity.
lore.primalspells.bounce_duplicate.desc: Duplicates the spell on each bounce.
lore.primalspells.random_path.desc: Makes the spell move in random directions.
lore.primalspells.sine_wave.desc: Makes the spell follow a serpentine (sine wave) path.
lore.primalspells.delayed_cast.desc: Holds the next spell, casting it when the projectile expires.
lore.primalspells.self_orbit.desc: Orbits the caster. Speed mainly increases rotation; radius grows gently between 2 and 6 blocks.
lore.primalspells.drone_swarm.desc: Summons 5 combat drones around the caster.
lore.primalspells.drone_bolt.desc: The weak bolt drones fire: low damage, but constant pressure.
lore.primalspells.gravity_field.desc: Creates a field that slows entities within its radius.
lore.primalspells.black_hole.desc: Strongly pulls entities and projectiles inward. The core deals 4 damage every 5 ticks, including to its caster.
lore.primalspells.teleport.desc: Teleports the caster to where it hits or expires.
lore.primalspells.quantum_entanglement.d: Duplicates the next projectile into two copies that orbit the main one with a sine motion; when any dies, all die.
lore.primalspells.energy_shield.desc: Passive: deflects incoming projectiles and absorbs external explosions. The breaking hit is blocked; later hits can pass through the breach. Each card adds 6 resistance; the 20-tick budget is 6 times card count cubed. Eight cards are mainly limited by mana. Piercing ignores shields.
lore.primalspells.resistance_budget: Single-card strength per 20 ticks: %s (scales with card count cubed)
death.attack.primalspells_projectile: %1$s was pierced by a magic projectile
death.attack.primalspells_projectile.pla: %1$s was pierced by a magic projectile cast by %2$s
lore.primalspells.dormant_crystal.desc: Sticks to blocks and stores spell energy. Flashes white faster near detonation; explodes at 600 ticks.
lore.primalspells.crystal_detonation.des: Arms your dormant crystals within 16 blocks of the cast point, with a brief warning.
lore.primalspells.chain_bolt.desc: A drifting bolt that jumps 4 times in 15 ticks. Seeks within 3 blocks, avoids its last two targets, or jumps forward. Speed extends reach; lifetime adds jumps.
lore.primalspells.long_distance_cast.des: Moves the cast origin forward 6 blocks, stopping at walls. Stacking is capped at 12 blocks.
lore.primalspells.plasma_beam.desc: Emits a 6-block beam blocked by walls. Deals 1.5 damage every 5 ticks to up to 4 targets; lasts at most 2s.
lore.primalspells.repulsion_field.desc: A 4-block field pushes magic and vanilla projectiles, including your own, for 120 ticks.
lore.primalspells.freeze_charge.desc: Converts direct hits to ice damage at 75% strength and briefly freezes. Explosions retain explosion damage.
tooltip.primalspells.stabilizing_seal: White seals close: casting interval recovered
tooltip.primalspells.charging_crystal: Blue conduits fill: spell sequence recharged
lore.primalspells.chainsaw.desc: Short-range cutting pulse. Resets cast delay at this card; reduces recharge by 3 ticks. Place last in a multicast for rapid fire.
lore.primalspells.self_damage: Self damage: can harm the caster

death.attack.primalspells_slice.item: %1$s was cut apart by a magic blade from %2$s using %3$s

death.attack.primalspells_ice.item: %1$s was frozen by magical frost from %2$s using %3$s

death.attack.primalspells_gravity.item: %1$s was crushed by a dark core from %2$s using %3$s
lore.primalspells.concentrated_light.des: Deploys a stationary focusing array with a locked direction. Fires after 20 ticks and bounces off walls 5 times. Casting gives a small kick; the array recoils visually when the beam fires.
lore.primalspells.recoil_boost.desc: Adds 0.35 cast recoil. Can propel the caster backwards.
